hero.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied original Taiwanese horror title-screen photograph into an exceptionally convincing, expensive live-action horror film still. Preserve this exact woman's recognizable Taiwanese facial identity, adult age, dark tied-back hair, faded small-floral long-sleeved blouse, dark skirt, turned torso and LOOKING BACK OVER HER SHOULDER pose. Preserve the quiet near-black LEFT 45% for menu type and the woman on the RIGHT, framed waist-up. Do not replace her with a statue, monster or another character.
Rework for exquisite physically believable realism: individual damp loose hairs, natural skin pores and peach fuzz, subtle uneven skin color, slightly dry lips, tiny creases in cloth, real woven red blindfold fibers, uneven old floral fabric folding under gravity around her shoulders. No beauty retouching, plastic skin, exaggerated pore sharpening or CGI rendering. Her expression is still, tense and unsettling; she seems to have stopped turning because she heard the viewer. No theatrical gore.
Her dark crimson blindfold must cover BOTH eyes COMPLETELY, opaque from above the eyebrows to upper cheekbones, no visible eye, eyelid or slit. Real knot and short frayed fabric tails at back of head. The Buddha behind her also has red cloth fully covering its eyes. Old Taiwanese temple at night: blackened gilded altar, bronze incense burner, two small dim candles, peeling red lacquer doorjamb, very restrained incense haze, damp stone floor. Objects look used and materially real, not evenly covered with procedural dirt.
Cinematography: a soft cool night source from a real off-frame doorway barely touches her cheek, loose hair and shoulder; faint candle warmth on her blouse. Large-format 65mm film, finely resolved textile and skin, smooth deep blacks with rich dark detail, restrained tonal contrast and natural desaturated color. Ash-black, muted skin, dirty floral cotton, blood-dark cloth. Quiet suffocating psychological horror, not a fashion photo. Preserve the original mood and woman-turning composition while greatly improving tactile realism and subtle dramatic lighting. 2:1 widescreen, highest detail. Left side must stay dark and usable for title/menu. No text, logos, UI, borders, neon, flames, motion streaks, HDR or fantasy armor.

wordmark.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create an art-directed title wordmark for a premium Taiwanese psychological horror FILM, not a fantasy game. Exact Traditional Chinese title: 說好不說. Four characters in ONE horizontal line, left to right 說 好 不 說. Only these four characters. No English, extra text, stamps or illustrations. Truly TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with actual alpha.
Original restrained hand-lettering: tall, narrow Chinese brush-script with a trace of old Ming letterforms, tense and elegant, varied brush pressure, strong contrast between thin and thick strokes, delicate long tapering terminals like scratches, subtly broken ink at selected edges. Individual irregularity and asymmetry but the balance of an expertly designed cinematic title. Clearly legible correct Traditional Chinese. NOT stock KaiTi. NOT thick muscular lettering. NOT a square block font.
First two characters 說好 are softly aged ivory ink; last two 不說 are deep muted cinnabar / dried blood red. Flat ink with some translucent disturbed fibers inside strokes, very fine worn patches, one extremely fine short red downward run naturally attached to a stroke end. Restrained, beautiful and chilling, a secret written by a frightened human hand. The lettering must remain sophisticated rather than noisy or crude.
ABSOLUTELY NO bevel, emboss, stone, metal, plastic, 3D extrusion, chunky outline, shadow, halo, glow, bright orange, yellow, gold, thick coagulated material or surrounding blood splatter. No background surface whatsoever. Flat brush ink only. Approximately 3:1 wide landscape canvas with small transparent margins, all letters and thin tails fully inside the frame.
